operationalLogic: The Dolphin Nautilus CC Plus operates by connecting to an external power supply via a floating cable and submerging into the pool. It utilizes two independent drive motors to power continuous rubber tracks, enabling movement across the pool floor, walls, and steps. As it moves, integrated scrubbing brushes rotate to dislodge dirt and debris from surfaces. Simultaneously, a powerful pump motor drives an impeller, creating suction that draws water and suspended particles through intake ports and into fine-mesh filter baskets for purification. Clean water is then expelled back into the pool through strategically placed outlets. The internal control board guides the robot's navigation through pre-programmed patterns and sensor feedback, ensuring comprehensive cleaning of the entire pool surface, including the waterline.

Water Outlets (Requires periodic checking for blockages)
